name: procureflow
description: ProcureFlow - Enterprise Procurement & Vendor Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
